description: Regression thresholds for the issue 7.2 large-session performance benches. `scripts/bench.sh --ci` runs the Criterion benches quickly and fails when a tracked benchmark's mean time exceeds its wall-clock ceiling (max_seconds) — a machine-tolerant guard that catches algorithmic/O(n^2) regressions rather than micro-noise. The percentage margins (max_regression_pct) bound run-to-run drift for the local baseline comparison (`scripts/bench.sh --check`).
